source.playersQuery: Every male 26.3.0 player, read in single-page slices (playerbase.gender=0, currentAbility=<v>, age range; pageSize 5000) and grouped by exact clubId.
source.selection: Male clubs of the FM nation (exact nation name, nation.nationCode checked) in reputation order (ties: efemScore desc, clubId asc), read in list pages of 100 with the reputation at each page end re-read whole (filter reputation=<v>), since pages shuffle tied clubs. Excluded: reserve, B/II, youth, under-N, university/school (outside senior competitions) and all-star sides (name rules plus EXCLUDED_CLUBS in scripts/lib/domestic-sync.mjs); fewer than 11 natural-position (proficiency >= 90) players or no natural goalkeeper. A club without an FM competition stays in as "Regional football". N = min(100, viable); a nation ships when N >= 10.
source.squad: Up to 16 players: the strongest natural 4-4-2 (1 GK, 4 DF, 4 MF, 2 FW) in the game's roles (FM_ROLES: lw/rw are forwards), players seated in Current Ability order whenever the filled shirts can be rearranged to fit them, then the best remaining by Current Ability.
source.loans: Not applied: EFEM's player list (views Default, ValueAndWage and Profile checked) gives only the contract clubId and no loan club, so a player out on loan is in his parent club's squad, not the squad of the club he plays for.
source.locations: Manual overrides (scripts/data/domestic-locations.json), then Wikidata football clubs of the country (venue P115 > P625 > HQ P159 > P131; multi-word exact/core name matches first, then one-word and leading-word subset matches pooled by sitelinks, dissolved items last; each item used once in reputation order; Brazilian state hints; when the club name holds a town, the first item property within 50 km of it is used, and a weak match whose own names hold another town must lie within 15 km of it), then the longest GeoNames cities1000 place name in the club name (own names beat other places' alternate names, alternate names only from places with a population, shortened ones weakest; limited to a province named in the club name or competition).
source.names: FM's own names, except unlicensed placeholders (e.g. "BRG") replaced from scripts/data/domestic-names.json; fmName/fmShort keep FM's.
